exploration.scope: Official agentscope-ai public repositories and their linked public documentation for Python AgentScope 2.0, historical Runtime/Studio, Java Harness/Service, and directly related UI/runtime components.
exploration.method: Read-only curl of GitHub metadata/raw files and official docs domains. No clone, install, execution, or live product test. GitHub REST metadata was queried before the unauthenticated rate limit was exhausted; later file content used raw.githubusercontent.com.
